# cardlio

> cardlio is a business card scanner and digital business card app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It reads business cards into complete contacts on the device — name, title, company, every phone and e-mail, the website and the full street address — in 28 languages, several cards from one photo. It is a free download with the first 10 cards free; one purchase, not a subscription, unlocks unlimited cards and every export. No account; no cardlio server stores your cards; App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.

Key facts:

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (App Store id 6773151080) and Mac (App Store id 6786612800). The two apps are unlocked separately; the library syncs between them through the user's private iCloud.
- Recognition runs on the device and works offline. Network is used only for the Apple Maps address check, optional cloud AI, Google / Office 365 / iCloud sync, the team library and creating an Apple Wallet pass.
- Exports: vCard, CSV, Outlook-ready CSV, Salesforce-ready CSV; one-click sync to Google Contacts and Office 365; save to Apple Contacts; a webhook to Zapier or Make for HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and other CRMs.
- Trade shows: Event mode tags each scan, Hot / Warm / Cold lead rating, Event Report (PDF / CSV), Follow-Up Run with drafted e-mails sent from the user's own mail app, and a shared team library (also in any browser at team.cardlio.app).
- Your own card: share as a link, QR code, NFC tag or Apple Wallet pass; e-mail signature and video-call background.
- cardlio never contacts the people you scan.
